svg.title: Head and the one visible ear in skin ramp 4. Three-quarter view turned about 25 degrees off strict profile, facing right - further than the torso, because a walking head leads the body. The turn is carried by the OUTLINE: a big smooth cranium behind, and a brow, nose, lip and chin profile on the leading edge. One ear, set well back. Cranium wider than jaw, never a circle. THE NECK IS NOT HERE: it is its own part, `neck-{skin}`, below the torso, so a collar can close over it. Six ramps, one derivation rule, no default tone.
